items.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Union Pacific, CSX and Norfolk Southern

items.title: 3 Railroad Stocks to Consider From the Prospering Industry

items.title: Union Pacific CEO’s Rate Remark May Have Silenced Merger Opponents, STB Says
items.summary: The board ordered UP to release video of CEO Jim Vena saying he might raise rates for shippers who don't support the Norfolk Southern deal.

items.title: Union Pacific vs. CSX: Which Railroad Dividend Is Better for Retirement?
items.summary: One railroad has the fatter yield, the other has the safer-looking payout cushion, and a pending megamerger clouds the picture. Three tests of income, coverage, and risk reveal which stock deserves a spot in a retiree's portfolio.

items.title: UP CEO’s rate threat adds wrinkle to Norfolk Southern merger process
items.summary: The railroad said Jim Vena’s remark about raising rates on shippers that oppose the merger was an “offhand comment.”

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: ‘Humor is good,’ Union Pacific CEO says of video rate threat
